name: Kinetic Film
mo_ta_vi: Chữ khổng lồ đập theo từng phách nhạc nhanh, máy lia vụt giữa các câu, nền đổi màu và không khung nào đứng yên.
summary: Beat-locked kinetic type at 160-175 BPM; huge words every beat, whip pans, ground flips, a hard drop.
character: The music is the clock: every beat brings one new thing (a word, a ground colour, a cut, a hit). Words fill the frame width, keep drifting after they land, and leave by a camera move, never a fade. Only the closing logo card may rest.

palette.rule: Three grounds: dark bg, brand accent, light paper. Flip the ground on every phrase change; type follows the ground (ink on dark, paperInk on light and accent). Accent colours only the word that matters.

typography: Archivo variable, weight 800-900, uppercase, 300-600 px on a 1920 frame; width axis 62-125 is part of the motion (stretch, squeeze, fill a width)
Measure every word once while visible and scale it to at most 88% of the frame width; if it must shrink below 200 px, split the phrase
JetBrains Mono 500 for small labels and counters
Be Vietnam Pro 600-700 for captions and any small Vietnamese line
layout: One idea centred per beat; big type stays clear of the caption band
Stacked pairs: a small kicker over a big word, or a big word sliding in beside a small one half a beat later
A picture, when used, fills the frame and is darkened (tint 0.25-0.4) under its words
material: Flat type; optional 3D extrusion built from 6-10 offset copies in a darker accent
Outline-only words for something not yet true, filled on the beat it becomes true
texture: Speed lines and a ring only on the drop and the title
camera: A camera wrapper always moves: 4-6% push and 0.5-1 deg roll across each block
Whip pans between shots, alternating horizontal and vertical, 0.18-0.25 s with a directional blur smear
Zoom through the hole of a letter (O, D, A, B, P, R, 0) into the next block
Small shake and scale bump on hits
transitions: whip pan with directional blur smear
collapse to a point, the next element grows from it
TV switch-off squash to a line then a point
hard ground flip on a downbeat

pacing.rhythm: Beat-locked: one new element every beat or half beat; runs of cuts accelerate 1, 1, 1, 1/2, 1/2, 1/4 beat then a flash. With a voice-over, words still land on the nearest beat to their spoken onset.

beat_response: Every downbeat brings a word, a ground flip or a cut
Landed words keep scaling 4-6% per second or sliding about 70 px/s (slower drift measures as still in qc-mp4)
Big hits: flash, shake, scale bump; ring and speed lines only on the drop
ui_choreography: UI appears only as a quick mock that a word strikes out (a timeline, a tile grid, a server rack), then dies on the next beat
diagrams: Numbers as one giant figure rolling on a slot reel, one every 3 beats
Input to output as three words far apart in one world, the camera riding a glowing comet between them
character_motion: No mascot; letters tumble in one by one, stretch on the width axis and squash on hits
captions: Optional karaoke line top left, Be Vietnam Pro 700 34 px; switch to ink colour on light grounds; drop it when the big type already shows the same words
sound: Instrumental drum and bass, phonk or breakbeat at 160-175 BPM with a clear drop; music stops dead on the logo hit
Every cut has a sound: hit on beats, whoosh on whips, riser into the drop, key clicks for typed text; hits sit above the music

signature_moves.name: Một chữ một phách
signature_moves.technique: each beat or half beat brings one new word filling the frame width, landing with a slam and then drifting
signature_moves.check: contact sheet at beat times shows a different word or ground on each beat

signature_moves.name: Lia vụt
signature_moves.technique: whip pan of the camera wrapper with directional blur between shots, alternating axes
signature_moves.check: the last frame before each cut is still blurred

signature_moves.name: Không khung nào đứng
signature_moves.technique: camera drift, sliding type, ghost rows or particles keep every frame moving until the logo card
signature_moves.check: qc-mp4 MOTION reports no hold above motion_gate.max_hold_s before the tail

signature_moves: Ground flips dark, accent, paper on phrase changes
strengths: Needs almost no assets beyond music and words
constraints: No still stretch longer than 0.6 s before the logo card
Every entrance timed with B(n) beats, never typed seconds
On-screen numbers come from the user or the source, never invented
No fades except the small lines of the logo card
avoid: More than two words on screen at once outside the logo card
Long sentences: split any phrase that would shrink type below 200 px
